g.text: Packet zoom: measured TM/DR with projected CLK/DL phase
Corrected DAC power scan-debug request 0x0000: timing with ADC current samples
Top and middle panels share reset-relative time. ADC samples are aligned by host monotonic timestamps and have ~0.6 s cadence; packet zoom shows clock-edge timing.
